roadmap_phase: Phase 2 - Agent Launcher MVP / Supervisor Loop
purpose: Define the input/output schema, derivation algorithm, and smoke-case plan for a NEW read-only MCP tool, aiworkhub_supervisor_loop_status, that implements B07's leg-4 observation (mcp_to_codex_status_and_handoff) over the LIVE queue: task_id -> supervisor_state + detected error. This artifact is design/schema ONLY. It adds no server wiring, no subprocess/exec/fork/shell/network code beyond what tools/aiworkhub/src/aiworkhub/core.py already runs read-only, and it patches NO source file. It does not enable real process launch and does not mutate any task status.
no_source_patch_marker: This task's allowed_writes contains zero paths under tools/aiworkhub/src/. No .py file is created or modified by this task. tools/aiworkhub is a nested git repo shared with other concurrent workers; any dirty src/ files observed at task time belong to OTHER in-flight tasks, not this one.

tool_schema.authority_profile: same_as_aiworkhub_task_codex_handoff_b116: frozen read-only contract, no write-gate toggle, no mutation parameters

runner.description: optional identity hint; when supplied, cross-checked read-only against core.check_runner_topic_allowlist -- never used to gate a write, only to detect runner_topic_mismatch for reporting

supervisor_request_id.description: opaque correlation id echoed back; not persisted to any new store

previous_snapshot.description: caller-supplied (Codex-held) prior observation of this task's status/worker_status, used ONLY to detect stale_task by comparison against the live re-read; the tool itself keeps no server-side snapshot store

reported_validation_verdict.description: caller-supplied out-of-band result of leg-3 (worker_cli_to_mcp_result_report); this tool never runs validation itself -- failed_validation can only be reported, never independently derived, matching B07's leg-3 reality_in_this_contract note

state.description: unchanged B02/B07 coarse state -- not_found means core.show_task returned no card for task_id

taskctl_status.description: verbatim core.show_task(task_id) result; null when state==not_found; taskctl JSONL/SQLite remains sole source of truth

supervisor_state.description: derived read-only per lifecycle_state_to_supervisor_state_mapping; null only when state==not_found

error.description: populated only when supervisor_state==blocked; exactly one of the 5 B07 error_taxonomy codes

derivation_algorithm.principle: Pure composition of functions that ALREADY EXIST in core.py, read-only, no new cue-router cognition added -- mirrors B07's neural_bridge_note carve-out (deterministic safety/support-boundary classifier, not a learned routing decision).
reused_functions: core.check_runner_topic_allowlist(runner, topic, action) -- runner_topic_mismatch detection, UNCHANGED
core.collision_guard(print_json=True) -> wraps scripts.build_tasking_parallel_group_collision_guard_v1.scan_collisions via taskctl collision-guard, UNCHANGED

ordered_steps.name: fetch_status
ordered_steps.on_miss: if the card cannot be parsed out of taskctl_status (e.g. 'task not found' in stdout/stderr): state=not_found, taskctl_status=null, supervisor_state=null, error=null; STOP

ordered_steps.name: runner_topic_mismatch_check
ordered_steps.action: if runner is not None or topic is not None: decision = core.check_runner_topic_allowlist(runner, topic, action='review'); if not decision['allowed']: error={code:'runner_topic_mismatch', reason:f'runner_topic_mismatch:{decision["reason"]}', detected_at_leg:1, blocked:true}, supervisor_state='blocked'; STOP

ordered_steps.name: missing_artifact_check
ordered_steps.action: for each path in card.read_first + card.allowed_writes (from taskctl_status card fields): if not Path(repo_root/path).exists(): error={code:'missing_artifact', reason:f'missing_artifact:{path}', detected_at_leg:1, blocked:true}, supervisor_state='blocked'; STOP
ordered_steps.note: pure filesystem existence check, no read of file contents

ordered_steps.name: collision_check
ordered_steps.action: guard = core.collision_guard(print_json=True); if not guard.collision_free: for fc in guard.file_collisions: if task_id in fc.conflicting_tasks: error={code:'collision', reason:f'collision:{fc.file}:{task_id}', detected_at_leg:1, blocked:true}, supervisor_state='blocked'; STOP

ordered_steps.name: stale_task_check
ordered_steps.action: if previous_snapshot is not None: cur = {status: card.status, worker_status: card.worker_status}; if cur != previous_snapshot: error={code:'stale_task', reason:f'stale_task:worker_status_changed:{task_id}:{previous_snapshot}->{cur}', detected_at_leg:4, blocked:true}, supervisor_state='blocked'; STOP

ordered_steps.name: failed_validation_check
ordered_steps.action: if reported_validation_verdict == 'failed': error={code:'failed_validation', reason:f'failed_validation:reported_by_caller:{task_id}', detected_at_leg:4, blocked:true}, supervisor_state='blocked'; STOP
ordered_steps.note: schema-reserved per B07 leg-3 reality_in_this_contract: this tool NEVER runs validation itself and cannot independently detect this condition in dryrun-only mode; it can only relay a caller-reported verdict

ordered_steps.name: clean_mapping
ordered_steps.action: no error condition matched: supervisor_state = lifecycle_state_to_supervisor_state_mapping[core._lifecycle_state(card)]; error=null; state='planned'

lifecycle_state_to_supervisor_state_mapp.note: Read-only projection of core._lifecycle_state's existing 5-value classifier onto the B07 supervisor_state vocabulary. Never written back to the task card. This IS the concrete mechanism B07's leg-4 response_schema referred to as 'derived read-only from taskctl_status via the SAME classifier core._lifecycle_state already implements ... mapped onto the supervisor vocabulary'.

smoke_cases.scenario: A real, currently-queued task card with no collision/mismatch/staleness/missing-artifact condition.
smoke_cases.call: core.show_task(<a real task_id from the live queue>)

smoke_cases.scenario: Two synthetic in-memory cards declare overlapping allowed_writes paths.
smoke_cases.call: scripts.build_tasking_parallel_group_collision_guard_v1.scan_collisions([synthetic_card_a, synthetic_card_b]) -- fixture cards only, never written to the live queue/taskdb
smoke_cases.expected: collision_free=false; conflicting task_id appears in file_collisions; derivation step 4 yields error.code=collision, supervisor_state=blocked

smoke_cases.scenario: A caller-supplied previous_snapshot disagrees with a re-read current snapshot (worker_status flips unclaimed -> claimed).
smoke_cases.call: derivation step 5 comparison logic against two synthetic snapshot dicts (no live queue read required for this case)

smoke_cases.scenario: Same 4 cross-validated examples as B07 (test [6/10]), reused verbatim against the UNMODIFIED live core.check_runner_topic_allowlist.
smoke_cases.expected: matches B07's 4 expected_reason values exactly (unknown_runner_topic_pair, per_wave_prefix_allowlisted [i.e. allowed, no mismatch], per_wave_action_not_allowed:start, codex_action_not_allowed:auto-pickup)

smoke_cases.scenario: A synthetic card's read_first list includes a path that does not exist on disk.
smoke_cases.call: Path(repo_root / '<nonexistent_fixture_path>').exists() -- pure filesystem check, no file content read
smoke_cases.expected: exists()==False; derivation step 3 yields error.code=missing_artifact, supervisor_state=blocked

smoke_cases.scenario: Caller reports reported_validation_verdict='failed' for a task_id (out-of-band leg-3 signal); the tool never runs validation itself.
smoke_cases.call: derivation step 6 relay logic against reported_validation_verdict='failed'
smoke_cases.expected: error.code=failed_validation, reason matches 'failed_validation:reported_by_caller:<task_id>', supervisor_state=blocked; contract documents this as schema-reserved / never independently derived in dryrun-only mode, same as B07 leg-3's reality_in_this_contract

no_credential_read.detail: This contract adds no code that reads credential/secret env values or files. Reuses core.py's existing _sanitize_env_for_audit() pattern conceptually: only env var NAMES + set/unset booleans may ever be logged, never values.

no_daemon_start.detail: No new long-running process, listener, or background loop. The MCP server remains the existing stdio request/response FastMCP process; this contract adds no additional daemon and no new server entrypoint.

no_real_process_launch.detail: aiworkhub_supervisor_loop_status is a pure read/derive tool: it calls only core.show_task, core.check_runner_topic_allowlist, core.collision_guard (all pre-existing, all read-only taskctl subcommands: show/collision-guard), and a filesystem existence check. It never calls run_taskctl with allow_write=True and never appends an audit entry.

no_writes_unless_explicit_future_gate.detail: Every task-status-mutating action stays behind the EXISTING AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES gate plus the B119 PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST prefix check. This contract adds zero new write paths and does not touch writes_allowed(), WRITE_COMMANDS, RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST, or PER_WAVE_RUNNER_TOPIC_ALLOWLIST.

future_source_patch_paths.note: Exact paths and additions a FUTURE coder task would make to implement this contract for real. NOT applied by this task -- acceptance criterion 'must specify exact future source patch paths but must not patch source in this task'.

neural_bridge_note.doctrine: Per AIWorkHub neural-control-first doctrine, adapter/runner/topic SELECTION for a real future launch must be a LEARNED routing + abstain decision, never a regex/keyword cue router. This contract adds NO cue router: derivation_algorithm is a static, human-authored safety/interface boundary (a deterministic classifier composed entirely of pre-existing pure functions), not a cognitive routing decision. Intelligence over which task/adapter/runner to dispatch remains deferred to the tracked migration below.
